Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities rebounded on September 16, with the Sensex gaining 333 points and the Nifty rising 99 points led by large caps. The market recovery followed a sharp sell-off on Tuesday, while broader markets continued to decline.

Markets.title: Sebi bars two entities over alleged cross-derivatives manipulation
Markets.summary: SEBI has barred two entities for allegedly manipulating small-cap stock derivatives through advanced futures and options strategies. The firms reportedly generated profits by intentionally incurring losses in stock futures to influence option prices.

Markets.title: Market Trading Guide: PVR Inox, Radico Khaitan among 5 stock recommendations for Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian equities gained due to easing crude prices, softer Japanese bond yields, and expectations of a US Fed rate hike. Analysts recommended Policybazaar, PNB, PVR Inox, Radico Khaitan, and Hindalco based on bullish technical setups and rebound potential.

Markets.title: Morgan Stanley shifts $10 billion in municipal bond mutual funds to ETFs
Markets.summary: Morgan Stanley is converting eight municipal bond mutual funds into seven new ETFs, shifting nearly $10 billion in assets. The firm is making this move to retain client assets by meeting the strong demand for tax-effective and flexible municipal ETFs.

Markets.title: LIC, Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs among anchor investors as NSE raises Rs 6,746 crore ahead of IPO
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange raised Rs 6,746 crore from 189 anchor investors, including LIC, Morgan Stanley, and Goldman Sachs, at Rs 1,785 per share. The offer-for-sale IPO is scheduled to open for public subscription on September 17.

Markets.title: UPDATE 1-J.B. Hunt shares tank as higher trucking costs prompt CFO's warning on possible profit drop
Markets.summary: J.B. Hunt shares dropped after its CFO warned of lower third-quarter profits due to rising transportation, diesel, and driver expenses. This news also caused share price declines for other trucking firms facing similar operational cost pressures.

Geo-Political.title: EU chief backs plan for Canada to become 'associate member'
Geo-Political.summary: Following a breakdown in relations with the United States under President Donald Trump, Canada is seeking closer ties with the European Union. In response, the EU chief has backed a proposal for Canada to become an associate member of the bloc.

Geo-Political.title: Eight children among 21 killed after war-damaged Gaza building collapses, rescuers say
Geo-Political.summary: Twenty-one people, including eight children, were killed when a war-damaged residential building collapsed in Gaza City. About 10 families had been living in the six-storey structure, which was previously struck by an Israeli raid last year.

Geo-Political.title: US accuses Russia of trying to kill Ukrainian allies overseas
Geo-Political.summary: The FBI has accused five men of conspiring to intimidate, threaten, and murder Ukrainian allies on U.S. soil and internationally. The United States claims that Russia directed this assassination and harassment campaign against its critics.

Geo-Political.title: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
Geo-Political.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman acknowledged valid public fears regarding the threats artificial intelligence poses to humanity. However, he and other tech leaders argued that companies have proper incentives to safely limit and manage these advancements.

Geo-Political.title: Eight German state premiers back Merz amid speculation over future
Geo-Political.summary: Eight German state premiers from the Christian Democratic Union have expressed support for Chancellor candidate Friedrich Merz ahead of two upcoming state elections. This backing comes amid ongoing speculation regarding the future leadership of the party.

Geo-Political.title: Saudi Arabia says it shot down Houthi drone south of Mecca
Geo-Political.summary: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen stated that it shot down a Houthi drone south of the Islamic holy city of Mecca. The Houthis denied that they were targeting the holy city.

AI & Tech.summary: An entrepreneur discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when asking ChatGPT for the best industry options. This visibility was achieved without paid advertising, demonstrating a shift toward AI-driven traffic in 2025.

Data & Insights.title: India clears 642 UK car imports under FTA tariff quota as first allocations roll out
Data & Insights.summary: India approved the import of 642 UK-origin cars under tariff-rate quota provisions following the implementation of the India-UK CETA trade pact. Seven of the eight applicants received quotas, with concessional import duties set to eventually decrease to 10%.

Data & Insights.title: EPFO ceiling reset after 12 years;  ₹25,000 threshold to cover 5.1 million more workers
Data & Insights.summary: The EPFO wage ceiling has been raised for the first time in 12 years to ₹25,000, bringing 5.1 million more workers under mandatory social-security coverage. While expanding this safety net, the change will also increase contribution costs for both employers and the affected employees.

Data & Insights.title: India-New Zealand FTA: New Zealand clears path for trade deal –  What it means?
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand has approved the parliamentary steps required to implement a free trade agreement with India. The deal establishes new measures for trade in goods and services, investment, agriculture, mobility, and customs procedures.

Data & Insights.title: New Zealand Parliament passes legislation to implement India FTA
Data & Insights.summary: New Zealand's Parliament has passed legislation to implement a free trade agreement with India. The landmark deal is expected to take effect in the second half of October, providing immediate duty-free access for over half of New Zealand's exports.

Data & Insights.title: It's a fake! Forged art floods Indian market as masterworks fetch record millions
Data & Insights.summary: Surging art prices in India have triggered a massive influx of forged masterpieces, particularly targeting renowned artists like MF Husain. Experts are now urging stricter authentication and provenance checks to protect buyers amid this growing market crisis.

Data & Insights.title: Explained | Why US Fed meeting outcome tonight matters more than any FOMC decision in last 3 years
Data & Insights.summary: Tonight's Federal Reserve meeting outcome is critical because it will signal the future direction of US monetary policy. Markets are closely watching the decision for clarity on inflation, interest rates, and the broader cost of money ahead of upcoming elections.

India.title: Rs 92 Crore via 1,000 Debit Cards: US Christian Group Charged With Illegal Funding, Link To 'Extremism'
India.summary: The CBI has charged a US Christian group with illegal funding after roughly 1,000 ATM cards issued by Truist Bank were used to withdraw about $9.99 million across multiple Indian states. Investigators allege these financial transactions are linked to extremism.

India.title: How India Managed Energy Crisis Amid Middle East Tensions
India.summary: Driven by Middle East tensions, the price of the Indian basket crude oil surged from $60–$70 per barrel in 2025 to over $130 per barrel by September 2026. India successfully managed this energy crisis through strategic countermeasures.

India.title: 4% Merchant UPI Payments Are Over Rs 2,000 But Drive 66% Of Total Value
India.summary: In fiscal year 2026, UPI recorded 24,162 crore transactions, with about 63 percent being Person-toMerchant payments. While merchant UPI payments over 2,000 rupees account for 4 percent of the total, they drive 66 percent of the total value.

India.title: Special Team Formed To Probe Gurugram Hit-And-Run, Top Cop Says
India.summary: Authorities in Gurugram formed a Special Investigation Team to probe a recent hit-and-run incident. The SIT will be led by Assistant Commissioner of Police Sushila Devi and includes four other police officers.
